🚀 Boost Your Recycling Conveyor Efficiency with the G Profile! ♻️

Introducing the G profile, engineered to maximize service life and reduce wear on conveyor belts in recycling processes. Its distinctive geometry:
✨ Minimizes material loss
✨ Reduces belt surface wear
✨ Lowers maintenance needs

Thanks to our unique hot vulcanisation process, the G profile is fully integrated into every Probelt® base belt, eliminating profile detachment. Built robust and reliable, it performs in even the toughest recycling environments, supporting continuous operation.

💡 Customizable options:
- Various profile widths
- Optional Hotcleat® side edge to reduce spillage

📐 Need the right fit? Our sales team can provide profile drawings for all available widths and help you select the perfect G profile for your conveyor.

🚧 Another Hotwall project successfully delivered.

This conveyor belt is equipped with our Hotwall warm-vulcanized sidewalls and our Hotcleat®, designed for maximum reliability and long-term performance.

Why choose Hotwall?
✔ Up to 2x stronger adhesion compared to cold-bonded sidewalls
✔ Resistant to temperature fluctuations and product influences
✔ Longer service life and reduced maintenance
✔ No fabric reinforcement required for standard applications

The result? A durable conveyor solution that keeps material exactly where it belongs, even under demanding operating conditions.

At LBS, we combine advanced Hotcleat® technology with years of expertise to create conveyor belts that perform when it matters most.

Together we create.

✔ Increased production capacity

One month after @ifatworldwide Munich 2026, we’re still looking back with energy and pride. IFAT was more than a trade show, it was a meeting point for innovation, collaboration, and the future of recycling.

Although visitor numbers were slightly lower on some days compared to previous editions, the quality of conversations made all the difference. We met new prospects, strengthened existing relationships, and built valuable international connections. Collaboration remains a key driver in our industry.

Across the market, we saw a clear mix of challenges and optimism: cost pressure, uncertainty, and project delays on one side, but continued investment in smarter, more sustainable recycling solutions on the other. The demand for integrated solutions focused on efficiency, reliability, and reduced downtime is growing fast.

IFAT also reinforced how important face-to-face meetings remain, many opportunities simply don’t emerge online.
Together with @rema_tip_top_ag group, we showcased how engineering, production, and global service combine into complete end-to-end solutions for customers worldwide 🌍♻️

We left Munich with strong leads, new insights, and even more motivation to drive the recycling industry forward.
A big thank you to everyone who visited our stand and shared ideas with us. Let’s continue the conversation and turn opportunities into successful collaborations.

Powerful Z-Belt solution through smart collaboration 🚀

When space is limited but performance can’t be compromised, engineering really matters.

In a recent international recycling project, Lubo Systems (@bollegraafrecyclingsolutions), LBS Conveyor Belt and Tempo joined forces to redesign a conventional conveyor into a compact, steep Z-belt installation, without sacrificing capacity, reliability or durability.

🔧 The challenge?
A space-saving Z-belt that could handle heavy waste material, maintain high throughput, and run smoothly through steep bends, while remaining warranty-proof for export to the US.

💡 The solution?
A complete technical re-engineering: from belt strength and cleat design to roll configuration and frame geometry. The result is a stable, low-maintenance Z-belt system that delivers consistent high capacity under demanding conditions.

🤝 What made the difference:
• Deep technical collaboration
• Data-driven design decisions
• One integrated engineering team instead of separate suppliers

The installation is now fully operational and performing exactly as intended, setting a new reference for compact recycling solutions.

Overbelt Magnets for Mobile Installations – Clean Material, Protected Machines

In mobile installations, unwanted ferrous metals can cause serious damage and costly downtime. Overbelt Magnets offer a reliable and efficient solution by automatically and continuously separating iron and steel from bulk materials — ensuring the cleanest possible end product and protecting downstream equipment.

Our Hotcleat® magnetic conveyor belts are specifically engineered for these demanding applications. Thanks to hot-vulcanised cleats on a highly abrasion-resistant rubber base belt, metals are securely captured and released exactly where needed. Even with small drum diameters, high belt speeds, and abrasive metal parts, performance and durability remain uncompromised.

Why Hotcleat® magnetic conveyor belts?
- No loosening of cleats due to poor adhesion, weather, or temperature changes
- Less sensitive to small drum diameters
- Reduced stress on drums and lower power consumption
- Extended service life of both belt and installation
- Environmentally friendly – no industrial adhesives used
- Cost-effective by minimising downtime

Our specialists have extensive experience with overhead magnets for mobile plants across Recycling, Agro, and Food industries. Whether it’s a proven application or a completely new challenge, we think along with you.
